newsitem.title: UK: BRIT says wins HCG bid.
newsitem.headline: BRIT says wins HCG bid.

text.p: The Benfield & Rea Investment Trust Plc (BRIT) said on Thursday it had won its bid for HCG Lloyd's Investment Trust Plc (HCG).
"The board of BRIT has declared the offer unconditional as to acceptances," BRIT said in a statement.

It said that as of September 12 it had received valid acceptances for 29.3 million HCG shares which, together with the 11.5 percent of its issued share capital already held, represents 56.4 percent of HCG's issued share capital.
A rival bid for HCG from CLM Insurance Fund Plc was last week extended for 14 days. BRIT's hostile bid for HCG on August 15 upset the proposed merger between CLM and HCG.
BRIT's offer was estimated to be worth 78 million stg compared with CLM's 72 million stg offer.
Both CLM and HCG were among the initial wave of corporate capital companies set up to invest in the Lloyd's of London insurance market.
BRIT said its offer for HCG would remain open for acceptance until further notice, adding that the cash alternative would remain open until October 3 and would close on that date.
